parameter.name: primaryInterpreter
parameter.label: Primary Interpreter
parameter.description: The primary human language interpreter to evaluate commands first.

parameter.name: secondaryInterpreter
parameter.label: Secondary Interpreter
parameter.description: The secondary human language interpreter to fall back to if the primary interpreter cannot process the command.

parameter.name: tertiaryInterpreter
parameter.label: Tertiary Interpreter
parameter.description: The tertiary human language interpreter to fall back to if both primary and secondary interpreters fail.
